page.title: Profile
page.subtitle: Manage your account and how you appear across qnop.

closer.title: Closer
closer.locked: See one of your reviews through to finalized

avatar.heading: Profile picture
avatar.description: Upload a photo so teammates recognise you. It is shown across the app; remove it to fall back to your initials.
avatar.constraints: PNG, JPEG or WebP · up to 1 MB
avatar.invalidType: Please choose a PNG, JPEG or WebP image.
avatar.tooLarge: That image is larger than 1 MB.
avatar.confirmMessage: This removes the profile picture and falls back to the initials avatar. A new one can be uploaded anytime.

crop.title: Adjust your picture
crop.hint: Drag to reposition, use the slider to zoom.

notifications.heading: Notifications
notifications.description: Emails about reviews you are part of — being added as a reviewer, new annotations, replies in your discussions, decisions, and status changes.
notifications.mentionsNote: Mentions reach you straight away either way — being named personally is the one case where waiting costs something.

DAILY.label: Once a day
DAILY.help: One summary each morning, in your timezone. Nothing is sent on a quiet day.

OFF.label: Never
OFF.help: No review emails. In-app notifications are unaffected.

tracking.heading: Usage measurement
tracking.description: Anonymous counts of which pages get used, so this workspace can be improved with evidence rather than guesswork. Page addresses are reduced to their shape first — never a document, never a name, never a search term. This choice follows your account to every device you sign in from.
tracking.toggle: Include me in anonymous usage measurement

timezone.heading: Time zone
timezone.description: Dates and times across qnop appear in this zone.

owned.title: Missions commanded
owned.empty: No reviews of {{name}}'s command are shared with you yet.

reviewing.title: Missions joined
reviewing.empty: {{name}} is not reviewing anything you share yet.

moves.title: Recent moves
moves.caption: In reviews you share
moves.empty: No recent moves from {{name}} in reviews you share.
